events.text: Vik: Thanks, Mina — come by around 10 in the morning for the repair drive on the front porch.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik — that would really help. I’m still lining up a few more people for Saturday on the front porch.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Vik: Thanks, Uli — I’m still organizing the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, so I’ll keep spreading the word for a few more helpers.
events.speaker: Vik
